findings.what: On Phone with Fast 3G and 4x CPU, the form looks ready after 1.7 s but hydrates at ~6.6 s; anything typed before that is wiped without notice (name and password came back empty; 'Enter your name' errors on submit).
findings.repro: Open /signup on a throttled phone, type name and password within 5 s, wait: fields are empty.
findings.fix: Keep typed values through hydration (uncontrolled inputs or read DOM values on hydrate), or disable fields until ready.

findings.what: A typo after @ (nutech.edu.pkk, nutec.edu.pk) says 'Your university isn't on Skilient yet. Request it', steering the student to request a university that doesn't exist.
findings.fix: For a domain close to a live one, ask 'Did you mean @nutech.edu.pk?' before offering the request.

findings.what: After submitting with an unknown domain, the 'Request it' link disappears from the message.
findings.repro: Type an unknown domain, press Create account.
findings.fix: Keep the request link in the submit-time message.

findings.what: 'This email is already registered. Sign in instead. Sign in' appears at the top of the form, not by the email field, with 'Sign in' twice.
findings.repro: Sign up with an existing email.
findings.fix: Show it under the email field: 'This email already has an account. Sign in'.

findings.what: A second wrong code shows the identical message; nothing shows the new attempt was checked or how many are left.
findings.fix: Re-announce the message (live region) and say attempts left.

findings.what: After the link is used on another device ('The tab where you signed up moves on by itself'), the phone tab, reloaded, still says 'Check your inbox' and restarts the resend timer.
findings.repro: Sign up on phone, open the email link on desktop and confirm, reload the phone tab.
findings.fix: On load and on focus, check confirmation and move on.

findings.what: Signing in before confirming the email goes straight to the code screen with no reason given, and no new code is sent although a fresh 60 s timer suggests one was.
findings.repro: Sign up, close, sign in later.
findings.fix: Say 'Confirm your email first. We sent a new code to …' and send it.

findings.what: The step says 'Skills you add yourself show as claimed', but there is no way to add a skill anywhere; without GitHub the step is empty.
findings.fix: Add 'Add a skill you have' (claimed) to the step and to /me/skills, or remove the promise.

findings.what: 'Open ventures at <university>: No open ventures yet' always; the step never loads ventures, though two NUTECH ventures were recruiting.
findings.repro: Finish onboarding at NUTECH with recruiting ventures present.
findings.fix: Load recruiting university/public ventures with open roles into the step.

findings.what: Back is a link, so unsaved username and intro typed on step 2 are lost.
findings.repro: Type a username and intro, press Back, then Continue.
findings.fix: Save drafts on Back (or keep them in the form state).

findings.what: 'That username is taken. Try another.' offers no suggestion.
findings.fix: Suggest two free variants.

findings.what: Time left jumps (6, 5, 4, 2, 2, 1 min).
findings.fix: Base it on remaining steps evenly.

findings.what: A signed-in student mid-onboarding who opens / sees the marketing page ('Open Skilient'), not their next step.
findings.fix: Redirect signed-in users to their current step or Home.

findings.what: Copy promises recruiters ('get recognised by recruiters', 'a CV that recruiters trust') while the recruiter portal is off.
findings.repro: Read the landing hero and welcome screen.
findings.fix: Drop or soften recruiter claims while portals are off.

findings.what: Batch list has 22 years (2011-2032) and Department 38 options with no search.
findings.fix: Default to likely batches; add type-ahead search to Department.

findings.what: A new entry shows 'Signing…' with no idea how long it takes.
findings.repro: Claim an entry and open the Record.
findings.fix: 'Signing, usually within a minute' and refresh when sealed.

findings.what: Points shown with decimals ('231.55 points'); /me/score says '1 of 6 tiers reached' while the student is at Spark (tier 2).
findings.repro: Open the progress sheet and score page as a Spark student.
findings.fix: Round points; count tiers reached including the current one.

findings.what: 'Take this step' opens the score explanation, not an action.
findings.fix: Link the next step to its action.

findings.what: After answering, the strip shows 'Answered · Change' in an empty well, not the answer.
findings.fix: Show 'You said Yes · Change'.

findings.what: When the change window ends (10 min), 'Change' disappears with no explanation.
findings.fix: 'Answers are final after 10 minutes' on hover/under the strip.

findings.what: Switching to Global Feed keeps the active filter (Shipped), so the Global Feed looks nearly empty.
findings.fix: Reset the filter on feed switch, or show it clearly with a clear button.

findings.what: Typing @ suggests no names; you must know the exact username.
findings.fix: Autocomplete friends and thread participants.

findings.what: After reporting: 'Thanks, we'll review this.' No timeline or where to see the outcome.
findings.fix: 'Usually within 2 days; you'll get a notification.'

findings.what: Keyboard users pass 14 rail and header stops before the feed; no skip link in the app shell.
findings.fix: Add 'Skip to content' to the app shell.

findings.what: Tick and cross are named only 'Yes' and 'No'.
findings.repro: Focus the tick with a screen reader.
findings.fix: Name them 'Yes: <question>' or group with the question as label.

findings.what: With a larger browser font size, controls (rem) grow but text (px) doesn't; the phone dock labels overlap and the search box squashes.
findings.repro: Set the browser default font to 32px; open /feed on a phone.
findings.fix: Size text in rem.

findings.what: 'swap' opens 'Skill swaps (Openings)' first; 'privacy' finds only Settings. The tour introduces 5 of 13 rail places.
findings.fix: Rank exact page names first; index settings sub-pages; one tour step for the rail's lower group.

findings.what: The code screen masks the address the student just typed (u*****w@…), so a typo can't be spotted.
findings.repro: Sign up and read the code screen.
findings.fix: Show the full address to the person who just typed it.

findings.what: New posts stay in a 2-hour 'seed' stage shown only to a sample; a brand-new student saw 2 posts while ~20 existed at their university.
findings.repro: Sign up and open Home within 2 hours of others posting.
findings.fix: Let posts from a student's own university reach small universities without the seed gate, or fill quiet feeds with older posts.

plan_fixes.change: Google OAuth isn't configured locally; run T003 on staging with a university Google Workspace test account.
Needs a staging GitHub App and running workers; the local stack can't reach github.com and Edge Functions don't boot in the cloud container.
The claim email needs the notify worker; locally use the welcome screen's claim card, or run on staging.
Use 'password123' (10+ characters, breached) to test the breached-password check; 'password1' only tests length.
Ask about L1/L2 only of testers who connected GitHub; without it the step shows no levels.
Name pages that have first-visit tips: Openings, a venture page, CV, score, Privacy centre.
The product now offers 'Hide until tomorrow', not 'Hide checklist'; update F04.07a and the task ('hide your progress for today; find where it went').
Setup must include posts older than 2 hours (seed stage) or the tester sees almost none; the seed script ages them.
The product locks answers after 10 minutes, not 15; say 'come back after 10 minutes' or 'later'.
Mute and the report target are the same helper in practice; say 'report first, then mute', or use a different person to mute.
Say which text-size setting (browser font size vs Android font scale); they behave differently.
